correctness.rationale: The seven complementary line tetrahedra have 28 mutually unique triangular faces. The order-seven action is free because no proper nonempty face is invariant. One full face/tetra orbit collapses equivariantly, leaving precisely the three quotient triangle attaching words a^2b^-1, ac^-1b, b^2c. CW generator eliminations give b=a^2, c=a^3 and the remaining degree-seven relation, so the quotient is the actual Moore homotopy type. The degree-seven regular cover is universal; its equivariant cellular complex has d2=N and d1=t-1, giving H2 the integral augmentation ideal. The standard-library checker checks all face orbits, chain matrices, and determinantal divisors.

value.rationale: The Fano-plane cap complex is the canonical full complex of line-avoiding point sets; its Singer action is a natural geometric symmetry, not an arbitrary numerical slice. Identifying its orbit space as a Moore space explains the exact seven-torsion caused by quotienting a torsion-free simply connected finite complex, with an explicit nonabelian cell presentation and integral covering module. Ordinary Betti numbers and rational symmetry characters do not determine this quotient-homotopy information. The geometry provides a concrete small construction connecting finite incidence designs, topological quotient spaces, and integral C7 representations.
